prospects.blocker: Deploy and verify the asset, then recheck the form and original-publication terms.

prospects.fit: The official AMA publication accepts first-person features and how-to material for model-aviation readers, including beginners.

prospects.fit: The application seeks experienced FPV pilots for practical flying, gear, maintenance, photography, and racing content with credited bios.
